entities.name: Query protein 329 aa
observations: Sequence length is 329 aa; estimated molecular mass 35.86 kDa and pI 6.61.
Pfam-like domains: ADH_N_2 at residues 5–106 and zinc-dependent alcohol dehydrogenase-like regions spanning approximately 154–327.
The sequence matches reviewed prostaglandin reductase 1 homologs at approximately 61–62% identity with 99% coverage and extremely low E-values.
Most likely an NAD(P)H-dependent oxidoreductase; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homology.

entities.name: Prostaglandin reductase 1
observations: Reviewed mammalian homologs are cytosolic NAD(P)H-dependent oxidoreductases of approximately 329 aa.
They reduce the 13,14 double bond of 15-oxo-prostaglandins and can reduce 15-oxo-lipoxin A4 and alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehydes or ketones.
They can also oxidize leukotriene B4 at C12 to form 12-oxo-leukotriene B4.
Associated EC numbers include 1.3.1.48 and 1.3.1.74; homologs are monomeric or homodimeric.

entities.name: 15-oxo-prostaglandin reduction
observations: General reaction inferred from reviewed prostaglandin reductase 1 homologs: 15-oxo-prostaglandin + NAD(P)H + H+ -> 13,14-dihydro-15-oxo-prostaglandin + NAD(P)+.
Mapped to Rhea reactions including RHEA:50584 and related entries.

entities.name: Alpha beta unsaturated carbonyl reduction
observations: The homologous enzyme reduces alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehydes and ketones using NADPH, including medium-chain alkenals and 4-hydroxy-2-nonenal.
Generic redox direction: alpha,beta-unsaturated carbonyl + NADPH + H+ -> saturated carbonyl + NADP+.

entities.name: NAD(P)H cofactor dependence
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated as NAD(P)H-dependent oxidoreductases; GO terms include 15-oxoprostaglandin 13-reductase [NAD(P)+] and 2-alkenal reductase (NADPH) activities.
